name: Forgotten Ego | Work In Progress
summary:
Embark on a perilous journey into the treacherous depths of Forgotten Ego, an ancient network of caves filled with deadly creatures, traps, and tantalizing treasures. As a brave adventurer, navigate these perilous caverns using both wit and strength to overcome monsters, puzzles, and mysteries. Gain experience, level up, and acquire new gear to enhance survival chances. Ultimately, face the monstrous Ego in a final showdown for unimaginable rewards and legendary status.
